literal: Love, knowledge, clarity of mind, absence of desire—these four, only with him who fully possesses them, lies trust.
translation: Trust should be placed only in that person who fully possesses these four qualities: love, knowledge, clarity of mind, and freedom from greed.
modern: அன்பு, அறிவு, தெளிந்த சிந்தனை, பேராசை இல்லாமை ஆகிய இந்த நான்கையும் நன்றாகப் பெற்றிருப்பவனிடமே நம்பிக்கை வைக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the four essential qualities a leader must look for when choosing an officer. These are: affection (அன்பு) towards others, wisdom (அறிவு) to make right choices, clarity of mind (தேற்றம்) to act without doubt, and freedom from greed (அவாவின்மை) to prevent corruption. Only in a person who possesses all four of these virtues fully (நன்குடையான்) should one place absolute trust (தெளிவு). The word 'தேற்றம்' specifically denotes a clear, unwavering mind that is free from confusion, which is crucial for executive action.
